samples.summary: New PR surface + three new harness modules ship with no design-doc update. `docs/design/harness-engineering.md` is the canonical doc for the agent harness and it enumerates every other PR comment surface and its trust rule — the paged latch, `<!-- agent-metrics-summary -->`, `<!-- agent-fix-effort -->` (line 1843-1845), the rebuttal/fix-report hidden records, the advisory `agent:*` label projection (line 904). This change introduces a fourth durable PR surface (`<!-- agent-loop-status -->`), a new author-checked upsert trust rule, a projection-never-a-gate contract, and three new scripts (loop-status.mjs, panel-job-summary.mjs, guard-verdict.mjs) plus a new `verdict` output on review-round-guard.mjs — none of which are recorded in the doc, and no task plan was added under docs/tasks/ either (only README.md exists there). CONTRIBUTING.md:13-16 and :56-58 require updating the existing area doc (and a task plan) for a non-trivial change; the harness doc's Phase 21 'Agent Observability Stack' section (line 345) is exactly where this belongs.

samples.summary: Inconsistent approach within the same change: the CI-iterate attempts guard renders its three job-summary blocks as inline `core.summary.addRaw(...)` strings inside github-script YAML, while the equivalent review-round guard decision was (correctly, per this repo's pattern) extracted into scripts/agent/guard-verdict.mjs with unit tests. The repo has explicitly moved such inline github-script logic into scripts/agent before (see the fix-brief.mjs comment in agent-review-panel.yml). The new inline strings are untestable and drift-prone.
samples.evidence: agent-iterate-ci.yml adds three addRaw blocks in the guard script; guard-verdict.mjs does the same job for the panel guard as a tested module.

samples.summary: Rollout-guard inconsistency: the branch-checkout call sites defensively skip when the script is absent (`[ -f ./scripts/agent/loop-status.mjs ] || exit 0`), but the `.trusted` (main checkout) call sites — `node .trusted/scripts/agent/panel-job-summary.mjs` (line 977) and `node .trusted/scripts/agent/loop-status.mjs` (line 1008) — have no such guard, so until this PR is merged to main those steps fail every run (masked only by continue-on-error). Either guard all of them or none; the mixed treatment reads as an oversight.
samples.evidence: .trusted is a checkout of the default branch; loop-status.mjs/panel-job-summary.mjs only exist on this branch.

samples.summary: Surface overlap with the existing metrics summary comment: `metrics.mjs summarize` already maintains a sticky `<!-- agent-metrics-summary -->` PR comment carrying cumulative effort and per-lens panel stats, and the new loop-status comment re-renders effort totals (`**Agent effort so far:** …`) from the same ledger. Reuse of the parsing helpers is right, but two sticky comments now report overlapping numbers on every PR; consider whether the effort line belongs only in the metrics summary.
samples.evidence: loop-status.mjs imports parseMetricComment/parseSummaryData/dedupRecords from metrics.mjs and renders its own effort totals block.

samples.summary: The status headline derives `ready: prView.isDraft === false`, i.e. any non-draft PR renders as 'ready for human review' — including a human-opened non-draft PR the panel just requested changes on, and including the interval between a manual undraft and the panel verdict. As a projection this can contradict the round table directly below it; deriving readiness from the ready-gate outcome (or from lens checks + CI, as set-state.mjs does) would fit the 'derived from unforgeable signals' contract the file states for itself.
samples.evidence: renderLoopStatus gives `ready` precedence over the caller's event, and main() passes prView.isDraft === false.

verdict.reason: Repo-wide grep for `loop-status`, `panel-job-summary`, `guard-verdict` and `session-job-summary` returns hits only in scripts/agent/*.mjs, two workflow files, and generated .agent-review/* artifacts — no .md file anywhere documents them. docs/design/ contains exactly one harness doc (harness-engineering.md) and no parallel observability doc; that doc has no occurrence of 'job summary', 'Step Summary', 'sticky', 'dashboard' or 'status comment', so the surface is not covered under an alternate name. The doc does enumerate the comparable surfaces and their trust rules (advisory `agent:*` label with the explicit 'projection, never a gate' contract at :915; the standalone `<!-- agent-fix-effort -->` marker and its sweep-exclusion at :1843-1848), and Phase 21 'Agent Observability Stack' (:345-363) is the live section this belongs in. CONTRIBUTING.md:13-16/:55-63 requires updating the existing area doc plus a docs/tasks/active plan for non-trivial changes. One correction to the finding's wording: task plans do exist under docs/tasks/active/ (19 dated 2026-08-01..05), so 'only README.md exists there' is inaccurate — but grepping that directory for this change's terms (loop-status, job summary, GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY, observability, sticky, status comment) yields nothing, so no plan for this change exists either. No counterexample found; the design-doc-discipline miss is real and major under this lens.
